data.long_meaning: Avimee is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Avi' meaning 'free from' and 'Me' meaning 'mind'. This name signifies being free from the bondages of the mind and attaining divine grace. The name Avimee carries the meaning “Divine Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Avimee usually hope their child will grow to embody divine grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Avimee is also mentioned in the Puranic literature, particularly in the Skanda Purana, where she is depicted as a goddess revered by the sage Agastya and is believed to bestow blessings of eloquence and learning.
